summary: Iteration 9 verification-only pass (NO collector/serper runs). Verified the _platform_for_url host-boundary fix, the /api/findings search-snippet fix, Welspun data completeness, and full Stripe/auth/export regression. 57 backend tests passed (100%), incl. 17 new unit cases for _platform_for_url. Frontend Social Media page verified end-to-end for Welspun (232 findings, pagination, platform filter, search, drawer, CSV+PDF export). No functional defects found.

Verified against 17 cases incl. upstox.com, ambitionbox.com, notx.com, fakelinkedin.com, mytiktok.com, t.me.evil.com => all None; in.linkedin.com/de.linkedin.com/m.facebook.com/old.reddit.com/t.me => correct platform.

rca_of_the_issue: Previous HIGH defect root cause: _platform_for_url used a substring test ('x.com' in url) so any host ending in the target string (upstox.com, ambitionbox.com) matched. Fixed by parsing the hostname and requiring exact-or-subdomain equality; 3 polluted rows were purged from the DB. Search gap root cause: build_findings_query's $or omitted evidence.snippet, so findings whose brand term appeared only in the snippet were excluded (213 vs 232); fixed by adding evidence.snippet + entities.account_name/description to the $or.
